name: Shma one-card (pure Unchained)

steps.note: summon: Unchained Twins - Rakea · other: Unchained Twins - Rakea · Summon Rakea from the deck and destroy it so it floats.
summon: Unchained Soul of Shiyama · Rakea destroyed: float into Shiyama.
target: Unchained Soul of Shma · Destroy Shma.
summon: Unchained Soul of Sharvara · Shma destroyed: summon Sharvara.
materials: Unchained Soul of Sharvara, Unchained Soul of Shiyama · Core goal of every combo.
search: Unchained Twins - Aruha · Yama CL1: search the other starter.
set: Escape of the Unchained · Sharvara CL2 in GY: set an Unchained trap.
target: Escape of the Unchained · summon: Unchained Twins - Aruha · Pop the set trap to Special Summon Aruha from hand.
summon: Unchained Soul of Sharvara · Set trap destroyed: summon an Unchained monster.
materials: Unchained Soul of Sharvara, Unchained Soul Lord of Yama · Link 3.
target: Unchained Twins - Aruha · summon: Unchained Soul of Shiyama · Destroy Aruha and revive Shiyama.
summon: Unchained Twins - Sarama · Aruha floats into Sarama; keep Yama's GY effect for later.
materials: Unchained Soul of Shiyama, Unchained Soul Rage Abominator · Link 2.
target: Unchained Soul of Rage · set: Escape of the Unchained · Reset Escape and destroy Rage so the Link 4 brings it back.
add: Unchained Soul of Sharvara · Rage destroyed: add a Fiend to hand.
materials: Unchained Twins - Sarama · Link 4 end board piece.
summon: Unchained Soul of Rage, Unchained Twins - Rakea · Enma Lord Yama revives two Unchained destroyed this turn.

notes: Optimal: set Reincarnation with Sharvara instead, search Prison, then the trap. Skull Meister is the only hand trap that matters on the Yama chain. Vs Imperm on Rage: Escape pops Rage, Yama in GY banishes to revive it. Very weak to Mulcharmy Fuwalos.
